name: Chillwind Point
summary: At Chillwind Point, cold drafts sweep a rocky rise above the mountain pass. Ancient troll ruins stand where Hillsbrad Foothills, the Alterac Mountains, and the Western Plaguelands meet, and Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives among the stones.

sections.title: A Bitter Crossroads
sections.body: Chillwind Point looks down over a ravine at Hillsbrad's edge. The pass leads into the Western Plaguelands, with the Alterac Mountains rising nearby. Long before Lordaeron claimed these routes, ancient trolls raised stone structures on the heights. Their weather-beaten remains still face the elements. Cold winds now blow south through the ravine, carrying the north's chill into the foothills below.

sections.title: The Windwatcher
sections.body: Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives among the old stones at Chillwind Point. The jungle troll hermit communes with the violent gales coursing through the gap. Though the heights are bleak and exposed, and Scourge-ravaged lands lie nearby, his camp is not entirely deserted. Travelers and shamans heading north often seek him out to learn the secrets of the mountain currents.

faq.answer: Chillwind Point is an ancient troll ruin on a high rise overlooking the pass between Hillsbrad, Alterac, and the Western Plaguelands. Biting drafts whistle through the nearby gorge and give the place its name.

faq.q: Is Chillwind Point the same as Chillwind Camp?
faq.answer: No. Chillwind Camp is the fortified Alliance and Argent Dawn outpost just north across the border, inside the Western Plaguelands. Chillwind Point is the ruined troll rise to the south.
Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives among the ruins at Chillwind Point. The friendly jungle troll studies the winds and aids elemental seekers and shamans who brave the pass.

faq.q: Why is it so cold here?
faq.answer: A narrow mountain ravine beside Chillwind Point funnels freezing drafts from the high northern regions and the blighted Western Plaguelands down into the lower foothills.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can study the pass's wild, funneling gusts with Bath'rah the Windwatcher. The hermit draws practitioners seeking elemental focus.
As an Alliance traveler, you find these ancient ruins just south of the border post at Chillwind Camp. Here, the contested foothills give way to the Plaguelands.
